findings.reason: Rule 1 merges any tasks from different agents that share component and layer, with no check that their tdd_phase is compatible. An ARCH GREEN task and a QA RED task for UserValidator would merge, and Rule 3 only pairs QA GREEN tasks. This is a defect in the planning spec rather than in executable code, so lowered to medium.
findings.claim: The MERGE rule can collapse RED test and GREEN implementation tasks for the same component, losing their TDD ordering.
findings.evidence: When Architect proposes a GREEN task for UserValidator and QA proposes a RED test task for UserValidator in the same layer, Rule 1 requires merging them solely because their component and layer match. It preserves DoD and dependencies but supplies no phase compatibility rule. Rule 3 subsequently handles only QA GREEN tasks, so it cannot reliably restore the lost RED/GREEN separation.
